title: Weg shared definitions
description: Types reused by every other schema in this folder. Not a document type of its own.

sublevelId.description: One of the 11 sublevels of the path, in order.

l1.description: A learner's first language. Weg explains in English or Spanish only.

text.description: A non-empty string with no leading or trailing white space.

explanation.description: Text written for the learner in both explanation languages.

example.description: A German sentence with its meaning in both explanation languages.

licence.description: The content licence allow-list from CLAUDE.md. 'original' means written for Weg and released under the repository licence.

source.description: Where a piece of content came from. Required for anything not original, so attribution can be shown in the app.

detail.description: Chapter, section, list name or sentence id inside the source.
